cohort: The study describes a case of a G2P1 woman in her second trimester.
finding: This case report highlights a rare occurrence of rapid onset Mirror Syndrome due to Rh-isoimmunization, resulting in intrauterine fetal death at 25 weeks of gestation in a previously nonsensitized woman, despite prior anti-D immunoglobulin administration and without clinical features of fetomaternal hemorrhage.
